parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of steel, rectangular in shape, and attached to the main body with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the safe, providing security and protection for the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, allowing or restricting access to the interior.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle mechanism of the safe, typically made of steel and mounted on the door.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to lock or unlock the door, engaging or disengaging the locking mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to operate the locking mechanism, controlling the door’s secure state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel panels forming the structure and housing the shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the structural integrity and protection for the contents stored inside, resisting external force or tampering.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports the door and internal components.
